LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.title: The Little Wizard
LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.cardsModifier: Little Wizard cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.description:
A ritual gone wrong bound a mighty wizard to a curse of endless cycles; each death sends her soul back into the past.
She returns to the simplest magic of the three Elements, seeking a way to break the curse within the Spire.
